C0998.title: 6 Arrested for Using Game Cheats for Boosting, Carries, and Score Selling
keywords: Ministry of Public Security Cyber Bureau
C0998.summary: In November 2025, the Ministry of Public Security's Cyber Security Bureau reported that Quanzhou cyber police in Fujian arrested six individuals, including suspect Xiao, for organizing the use of cheat software for profit.
